market_question: Will the price of Bitcoin be above $76,000 on May 17?
reasoning: Bitcoin is currently around $83k, above $76k, but the market's 94% implied probability of staying above $76k by May 2026 seems too high. Historical cycles suggest a bear market could be underway by then, making a drop below $76k plausible. I estimate the true probability of Yes closer to 80%.
evidence_points: Bitcoin historically enters bear markets 12-18 months after halving; May 2026 is 2 years post-2024 halving.
Current price of ~$83k means only an 8.5% drop is needed to breach $76k.
Long-dated options and futures show wider implied distributions, not a 94% confidence of staying above $76k.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Bitcoin price history and halving cycles
